title: Victoria Beckham’s Hands-on Approach Shapes Her Beauty Brand’s Middle East Debut
summary: The designer talks wear-testing, kajal and how beauty and fashion feed each other ahead of the Nov. 20 launch with Ounass and Bloomingdales.ae.
